camel_example: aliyun rds ModifyDBInstanceSecurityGroupRule --region cn-hangzhou --PortRange '1/200' --Description zht_test --DBInstanceId 'rm-bp15i4hn07r000000' --SourceCidrIp '192.XX.XX.100' --IpProtocol TCP --SecurityGroupRuleId 'sgr-2ze17u000000'
description_en: Modifies a security group rule that is configured for an ApsaraDB RDS for SQL Server instance
description_zh: 该接口用于修改RDS SQL Server实例的安全组规则
kebab_example: aliyun rds modify-db-instance-security-group-rule --db-instance-id rm-bp15i4hn07r000000 --security-group-rule-id sgr-2ze17u000000 --port-range 1/200 --ip-protocol TCP --source-cidr-ip 192.XX.XX.100 --description zht_test --region cn-hangzhou
name: ModifyDBInstanceSecurityGroupRule

parameters.description_en: The ID of the instance. You can call the [DescribeDBInstances](~~2628785~~) operation to query the IDs of instances.
parameters.help_en: The ID of the instance. You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2628785.html operation to query the IDs of instances
parameters.name: db_instance_id

parameters.description_en: The ID of the security group rule. You can call the [DescribeDBInstanceSecurityGroupRule](~~2834044~~) to obtain the ID of the security group rule.
parameters.help_en: The ID of the security group rule. You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2834044.html to obtain the ID of the security group rule
parameters.name: security_group_rule_id

parameters.description_en:
The range of destination ports over which TCP and UDP traffic is allowed in the security group rule.

Valid values: 1 to 65535. Separate the start port number and the end port number with a forward slash (/). Example: 1/200.
parameters.description_zh:
目的端安全组开放的传输层协议（TCP/UDP）相关的端口范围。

取值范围为1~65535。使用斜线（/）隔开起始端口和终止端口。例如：1/200。
